responsibility: Implements GCC’s type and object storage-layout engine. It computes sizes, alignments, modes, and field placement for declarations and types; manages sizetype nodes; lays out records, unions, bit-fields, fixed-point and other scalar types; handles variable and self-referential size expressions; and provides low-level helpers such as selecting efficient machine modes for bit-field accesses and deriving mode bounds, making it the core authority on language-independent storage representation before code generation.
same_name_distinction: Implements storage-layout decisions and algorithms, including variable-size handling, record/bit-field layout, sizetype setup, and machine-mode selection helpers like get_best_mode and get_mode_bounds; unlike gcc/stor-layout.h, which only publishes the layout and type-construction interfaces.
